summary_1line: Ruru mourns Pramadvara’s snakebite death, trades half his life to revive her, they marry, and he vows to destroy all serpents.

image_candidates.scene_text: Pramadvara lies pale and motionless on the forest floor after the serpent’s bite while sages gather around her grieving.
Ruru weeps alone in a deep forest as a radiant celestial messenger appears before him with the offer to restore his bride.
Pramadvara rises as if from sleep, restored to life by half of Ruru’s lifespan as divine figures look on.
